notes: Kev-0.8B (litert-community/Kev-0.8B-LiteRT v2); source jaredpalmer/kev-0.8b @ v1.0 (Apache-2.0) on Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, d = 1024. Typed decisions (noul / choice / score) over a state and a question, rendered with the author's to_record + encode (Kev repo tokenizer.json). Row graph = state-free row prefill, one signature serving_default: ids int32 [1,L] + valid float32 [1,L] -> hidden float32 [1,L,d] (after the final RMSNorm, every position). The pointer head and the answer shaping run on the host in fp32. Storage: FULLY_CONNECTED weights fp16 (FLOAT_CASTING, DEQUANTIZE), embedding table int8. Rows L64 / L128 / L256 = form C7 (form C + a size-1 SUM after the in_proj_z and q_proj FCs; fp32-identical to C). Shipping GPU setting: GpuOptions(precision = FP16_WITH_FP32_ACCUM). This file: kev-0.8b_rowprefill_L128_fp16fc_i8emb.tflite (form C7). artifact_sha256 = its Hub LFS oid (anonymous API tree read 2026-10-19 12:44 JST, litert-community/Kev-0.8B-LiteRT main ffdb1f7d; the file's bytes are unchanged since the v2 upload), equal to the sha256 the phone computed on its copy and to the run's inputs.sha256. The phone: its own Pixel 8a (8 GB, Mali-G715), the first Mali phone to run a Kev file; the Galaxy S26 records of this file are under 2026-10-05. The same file's run on a cloud-lab Pixel 8a (run 19 B, 2026-10-17, C-API runner) is side evidence only, not a record.
